我的生活与健康生活(My Life and a healthy life): 一篇关于健康生活的A2短文:马克斯与汤姆的经历和小计划。

Max borrowed a book about English from the bookstore. Last Wednesday, Max and Tom went to the health check. Life is full of small surprises. Also, the dove was released symbolically at the peace ceremony.
Max learned a lot about English. The weather was rainy that day. Max and Tom had great fun there. Granddad kept an old silver sixpence from the 1950s.
Max bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Tom's birthday is in May. It takes twenty minutes to get to the health check by bike. The road safety campaigner visited our school.
They took many photos at the swimming pool. Max thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like rice and tea.
